prompts.consent: Welcome to the VoiceTriage health line. This service gives guidance, not a diagnosis. To let the clinic know you are coming, and to share your answers and phone number with them, press 1. To continue without sharing, press 2.
prompts.invalid: Sorry, I did not understand. Please try again.
prompts.yes_no_hint: Press 1 for yes. Press 2 for no.
prompts.region_menu: Which county are you in? Press the number after the name of your county.
prompts.alert_sent: The facility has been told you are coming.
prompts.no_alert: The facility has not been told. Please go to the facility.
prompts.disclaimer: Remember, this service only gives guidance. If you are worried, go to a health facility.
prompts.who: Who is sick? Press 1 for a child under 5 years. Press 2 for a pregnant woman. Press 3 for anyone else.
prompts.c_drink: Is the child unable to drink or breastfeed, or vomiting everything?
prompts.c_fits: Has the child had fits, or is the child very sleepy, floppy, or hard to wake?
prompts.c_breath: Is the child breathing fast or with difficulty, or is the chest pulling in?
prompts.c_young: Is the child younger than 2 months?
prompts.c_diarrhoea: Does the child have blood in the stool, or signs of dehydration such as sunken eyes?
prompts.c_fever: Has the child had a fever for more than 2 days?
prompts.c_worse: Is the illness getting worse, or not getting better?
prompts.p_bleeding: Is she bleeding from the vagina?
prompts.p_fits: Has she had fits, lost consciousness, or become confused?
prompts.p_headache: Does she have a severe headache, blurred vision, or sudden swelling of the face or hands?
prompts.p_breath: Is she having difficulty breathing, or severe belly pain?
prompts.p_waters: Has her water broken, or is the baby moving much less than usual?
prompts.p_worse: Is she feeling worse, or do you have any other worry?
prompts.a_unconscious: Is the person unconscious, confused, or having fits?
prompts.a_breath: Is the person having difficulty breathing, or chest pain?
prompts.a_bleeding: Is there heavy bleeding that will not stop, vomiting of blood, or black stool?
prompts.a_belly: Does the person have severe belly pain, or vomiting so much that fluids will not stay down?
prompts.a_fever: Has the person had a fever for more than 2 days?
prompts.a_cough: Has the person had a cough for more than 2 weeks?
prompts.a_worse: Has the illness lasted more than 3 days, or is it getting worse?
prompts.outcome_emergency: This may be an emergency. Go to the nearest health facility immediately. If you cannot get there quickly, ask someone to take you now.
prompts.outcome_today: Please go to a health facility today.
prompts.outcome_3days: Please visit a health facility within three days. If things get worse, go immediately.
prompts.outcome_home: For now you can care for the patient at home. Rest and drink plenty of fluids. If danger signs appear or things get worse, go to a health facility. You can also call again.
